verdict_reason: The readable official evidence shows a self-serve Intuit developer account/app path and OAuth 2.0-only authentication, with API domains covering Accounting, Payment, and Payroll and documented production rate limits. Endpoint-level breadth, SDKs, sandbox, and versioning could not be verified because the main developer docs returned JS shells, but no sales or partner gate appears in the readable evidence.
open_questions: developer.intuit.com API reference/get-started/OAuth pages returned only a JS shell ('Compiling and pre-filling your Intuit info...'), so endpoint count, API type, SDKs, sandbox, versioning, and deprecation policy could not be verified.
OAuth scope names and the full permissions list could not be read; only a general statement that clients request scopes was available.
The official MCP help URL documents a US-only QuickBooks connector for Claude, not a published generic MCP endpoint; independent-client authentication and endpoint details remain unresolved.
No readable official source confirmed whether public app distribution requires app review/partner-program approval or platform service fees.
Sandbox/test environment documentation was not included in readable SOURCES; sandbox availability remains unverified.
API access cost/free tier is not explicitly stated in the readable sources; classification as self_serve_free rests on self-serve developer account/app creation without a documented paid gate.
